learning_outcomes.text: Explain the goals and limits of AI-assisted secure review
Identify common vulnerability classes with AI support
Detect secret, data-exposure and dependency risks
Triage findings by exploitability and impact
Remediate findings and verify the fix
Communicate findings and residual risk responsibly

integrative_case: A fintech service must pass a security review. Use AI-assisted review to find injection, auth and secret-handling flaws across the codebase, triage and prioritise them, remediate with verification, and avoid introducing new weaknesses, then report residual risk.
